cover_headline: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients in Remission, Study Finds
facts: An estimated 60.9% of adults with early Type 2 diabetes achieved remission at six months
Average HbA1c fell from 7.32% to 6.27%, and average weight fell by 4.67 kg
Walking on at least 80% of days gave 8.24 times the adjusted odds of remission

end.headline: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients in Remission, Study Finds
end.line: In an 87-person Maharashtra trial, a traditional Indian diet plus a 40-minute daily walk produced an estimated 60.9% remission rate at six months.
